description: A production-ready 250-piece Lego assembly studio with step-by-step 3D instructions, raycast ghost snapping, sub-assembly modules, explode view, JSON persistence, and a custom authoring studio.

tokens.note: Snapshot from the OpenCode session record when the project was packaged. total = input + output + reasoning. Cache reads/writes are reported separately because they are a subset of context usage. The final response and any post-snapshot publishing actions are outside this count.

cost.note: As reported by the OpenCode session record.

verification: Exactly 250 generated placements; 0 out-of-bounds bricks; 0 overlapping stud cells.
250 sequential snaps reach completed=true and render the completion dialog.
localStorage persistence, JSON progress import, and custom authoring import verified.
Authoring placement, 90-degree rotation, undo/clear, and 250-piece limit paths verified.
Responsive layout checked at 390px and 1600px; no horizontal overflow at the mobile breakpoint.
Three.js scene rendered in headless Chrome without JavaScript errors after the InstancedMesh colour-buffer fix.
credits: Built with OpenCode and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The app, procedural brick engine, 250-step model, UI, screenshots, and documentation were produced in a single agent session.
